fields.Name: T71 - Event Sessions Browse
fields.Description: Verifies the 'Event Sessions' entity grid loads in Data Explorer and shows session records with speaker/CEU fields, or a valid empty-state if none seeded.

InputDefinition.goal: In MJ Explorer, go to Data Explorer (Data section) and open the 'Event Sessions' entity from the entity tree. Confirm the row grid loads and shows session records with speaker/CEU-related columns, or a valid empty-state message if no sessions are seeded. Pages can take 10-30s to load - wait, do not navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The 'Event Sessions' entity is open in Data Explorer with its grid rendered
Session rows are visible with speaker/CEU-related columns, or a clear empty-state message is shown
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
